overview: Arlington Catholic High School defeated Medford High School 20-6 in a varsity football game. Medford mounted a fourth-quarter touchdown drive following a quarterback change, but Arlington Catholic responded with a late touchdown to secure the win.

items.title: First Quarter
items.summary: Arlington Catholic won the coin toss, and both defenses held each other scoreless through the opening quarter.

items.title: Second Quarter
items.summary: Arlington Catholic built a 14-0 halftime lead following touchdown plays by Brady Cassidy and Jordan Nash.

items.title: Halftime Performance
items.summary: The Medford High School Marching Band performed on the field during halftime.

items.title: Third Quarter
items.summary: Medford introduced Devin Brown at quarterback to generate offense, but penalties and a red-zone fumble kept Medford scoreless.

items.title: Fourth Quarter
items.summary: Medford cut the deficit with a Devin Brown quarterback sneak, but Arlington Catholic answered with a touchdown run by Tyler Venezia to close out a 20-6 victory.
